Writhe and the regular-isotopy value D require a chosen diagram, whereas Q and F are ambient invariants. The intended identity is correct for each chosen diagram representing K, but that diagram choice should be explicit in this statement.

The required precision is to quantify that diagram explicitly while retaining braid independence, the full conversion, AC, and every boundary/smoothing case. This is a domain/notation defect, not an incorrect conversion formula.

required_own_edits.source_excerpt: Assume the Axiom of Choice. Let $K$ be a nonempty oriented link with determinant writhe $w(K)$ and component count $c(K)$, and let $Q_K$ be the value returned by the BMW braid-closure algorithm for any finite signed braid word representing $K$.
required_own_edits.proposed_replacement: Assume the Axiom of Choice. Fix any nonempty oriented regular link diagram $K$, with determinant writhe $w(K)$ and component count $c(K)$. Let $Q_K$ denote the value returned by the BMW braid-closure algorithm for any finite signed braid word whose closure represents the oriented link represented by $K$. The quantities $D_K$ and $L_K$ below are evaluated on this fixed diagram; $F_K$ and $Q_K$ depend only on its ambient oriented link type.
